text: CHIEF SPOT-CHECK of the 45-count, which partly rested on a regex over companion bodies rather than on reading. Read the three highest-stakes entries; NO FALSE POSITIVES. ValidatedVector.of rejects dimension mismatch, non-finite values, non-L2-normalized vectors and the zero vector - four checks, all bypassed by fromProduct, so a consumer holding a ValidatedVector may hold NaN while every downstream distance, neighbour ranking and geometry comparison computes on it as validated. That single fact is the P1 justification. StorySource.fromText rejects empty text (forgeable to an empty source). EmbeddingReceipt.of rejects withheld identities describing a provider call and keyed items without keyed outputs - both PRIVACY invariants, both forgeable. SLICE ORDER CONFIRMED BY EVIDENCE rather than by intuition: embed-core first, then core, then the rest. EVIDENCE STANDARD NOW BINDING for the remaining 43, set by m1: DEMONSTRATE the forge in one line for at least one type per slice, plus a mutation showing the closed version rejects it. The chief has NOT executed a forge against ValidatedVector (three actors hold sbt; not starting a fourth console to prove what source and bytecode already show) - whoever takes embed-core runs it first, and if it does not reproduce, say so and the count will be withdrawn rather than defended.
